title: Delivery Times & Charges
body:
Production and delivery information

Most Foxy Printing products are made or personalised to order. Production time depends on the product, quantity, personalisation and seasonal demand.

Dispatch estimates

Check the product page and checkout for the delivery services available for your order. Orders containing several product types may be dispatched together when every item is ready.

Personalised orders

Production cannot begin until all required names, ages, photographs or wording have been supplied clearly. Missing information may delay dispatch.

Weekends and bank holidays

Orders placed late on Friday, during a weekend or on a bank holiday may not enter production until the next working day.

Delivery upgrades

Where upgraded delivery is available, it changes the carrier service after dispatch; it does not necessarily shorten the time required to manufacture a personalised item.

Need an order update?

Email sales@foxyprinting.co.uk or call 01439 771468. Include your order number.

title: About Foxy Printing
body:
Personalised printing from a UK production team

Foxy Printing creates personalised gifts, party products, mugs, cards, posters, face masks, stickers and printed merchandise for customers throughout the UK.

The store is operated by an experienced commercial print team producing custom products for birthdays, celebrations, supporters, businesses and events. Many items are designed, printed and finished in-house, allowing us to offer a large catalogue alongside made-to-order personalisation.

What we produce

  • Personalised mugs, cards and gifts
  • Party face masks and custom photo products
  • Posters, artwork and supporter gifts
  • Printed clothing, stickers and event merchandise

Our approach

We focus on clear personalisation, practical pricing and secure packaging. Because personalised products depend on the information supplied, customers should check names, ages, dates and spellings carefully before submitting an order.

Questions about an order or custom request can be sent to sales@foxyprinting.co.uk.

title: Frequently Asked Questions
body:
Frequently Asked Questions

How do I supply personalisation?

Enter the requested name, age, wording or other details using the option shown on the product page. If no box is available, follow the instructions in the listing or email us immediately after ordering.

Should I check spelling?

Yes. Personalised items are normally produced using the information supplied with the order. Check all names, dates, ages and messages before submitting payment.

Can I upload a photograph?

For photo products, use a clear, high-resolution, front-facing image. Avoid screenshots, heavily cropped faces, strong shadows and blurred images.

How quickly will my order be dispatched?

Production times vary by product and season. Any estimated dispatch information shown on the product page or at checkout should be treated as the guide for that order.

Can I change an order after placing it?

Contact us immediately. If production has already started, changes to a personalised item may not be possible.

What if my item arrives damaged or incorrect?

Email sales@foxyprinting.co.uk with your order number and clear photographs of the product and packaging so the issue can be reviewed.

Can personalised products be returned?

Change-of-mind cancellation rights normally do not apply to goods made to a customer’s specification or clearly personalised. This does not affect your rights if an item is faulty, damaged or not as described. See our Returns and Refund Policy for details.

title: Returns, Refunds & Cancellations
body:
Returns, refunds and cancellations

We want orders to arrive correctly and in good condition. This policy explains how to report a problem, cancel an eligible order or request a return.

Faulty, damaged or incorrect items

If an item arrives faulty, damaged, incorrect or not as described, contact sales@foxyprinting.co.uk with your order number and clear photographs of the product and packaging. Your statutory rights are not affected by this policy.

Personalised and custom-made products

Change-of-mind cancellation rights normally do not apply to goods made to your specification or clearly personalised. This includes products printed with a supplied name, age, photograph, message, logo or other custom detail. This exception does not remove your rights where goods are faulty, damaged, incorrect or not as described.

Non-personalised products

For eligible non-personalised goods bought online, tell us within 14 days of receiving the item if you wish to cancel. You then have a further 14 days to return it. Unless the item is faulty or we agree otherwise, you are responsible for the direct cost of returning a change-of-mind item.

Goods may be inspected as they would be in a shop, but we may make a lawful deduction where handling has reduced their value.

Refund timing

Eligible refunds will be processed within 14 days of receiving the returned goods or receiving evidence that they were sent back, whichever applies first. Refunds are made to the original payment method. For an eligible cancellation, the basic outbound delivery charge is refunded; any additional cost chosen for an enhanced delivery service is not normally refundable.

Before returning anything

Contact us first so the return can be identified and the correct instructions supplied. Do not send an item without including the order details.

Contact

Email sales@foxyprinting.co.uk or call 01439 771468.

title: Trade Accounts & Designer Programme
body:
Are you a printer, a crafter, a small business or a designer? Foxy Printing has been printing personalised gifts in our North Yorkshire workshop for years, and we'd love to work with you. There are two ways to join us.

Trade accounts for printers, crafters and businesses

Open a trade account to buy printing and print-ready supplies at trade prices for your own business. It's ideal if you:

  • run a print, craft or gift business and need DTF or UV DTF transfers, stickers and labels printed for you;
  • want your own designs printed on mugs, glassware, clothing, cushions and more, unbranded and ready to sell;
  • order business printing regularly, such as business cards, flyers, labels and signs.

Once your account is approved, we'll set up trade pricing on your customer account and talk you through artwork set-up and turnaround times.

Designer programme: sell your designs on Foxy Printing

If you create original artwork, slogans or illustrations, we can turn them into products on foxyprinting.co.uk. We print, pack and post every order, handle the customer service, and pay you a commission on every sale of your designs.

  • Send us a few examples of your work using the form below.
  • We'll pick the designs and products that suit them, and agree the commission with you before anything goes live.
  • Your designs are credited to you on the product page and in your own designer collection.
  • You get a sales report and commission payment every month.

Please send only artwork that you created and own. We can't accept designs that use someone else's characters, logos, brand names or photos.

Apply

Fill in the form below and we'll be in touch within a few working days. If you'd rather talk first, call us on 01439 771468.

title: Adult T-Shirt Size Guide
body:
Our adult personalised T-shirts are printed on the AWDis 150 T, a relaxed-fit unisex tee in 150gsm cotton. Use the measurements below to choose your size. If you're between sizes, go up a size for a looser fit.

Size Chest (pit to pit) Body length Sleeve length
S 48 cm / 18.9" 71 cm / 28.0" 22 cm / 8.7"
M 52 cm / 20.5" 73 cm / 28.7" 23 cm / 9.1"
L 56 cm / 22.0" 75 cm / 29.5" 24 cm / 9.4"
XL 60 cm / 23.6" 77 cm / 30.3" 25 cm / 9.8"
2XL 65 cm / 25.6" 79 cm / 31.1" 26 cm / 10.2"
3XL 70 cm / 27.6" 82 cm / 32.3" 27 cm / 10.6"
4XL 75 cm / 29.5" 85 cm / 33.5" 27 cm / 10.6"
5XL 80 cm / 31.5" 88 cm / 34.6" 27 cm / 10.6"

How to measure

  • Chest: lay a T-shirt that fits you well flat and measure straight across from armpit to armpit.
  • Body length: measure from the highest point of the shoulder, next to the collar, down to the hem.
  • Sleeve length: measure from the shoulder seam to the end of the sleeve.

All measurements are approximate, give or take 2 cm. Unsure? Call us on 01439 771468 and we'll help you pick.
